name: ENISA SME Cyber Resilience Maturity (CRA self-check) import
description: Imports a filled-in copy of ENISA's official SME Cyber Resilience Maturity Assessment tool (CRA_Maturity_Model_TOOL.xlsx, from enisa.europa.eu/publications/sme-cyber-resilience-maturity-assessment-model, July 2026, TLP:CLEAR) into XORCISM's native /cra-maturity cockpit. The model is a Cyber Resilience Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/2847) readiness self-check for SMEs making products with digital elements: 25 questions across five domains (governance & documentation; risk management & security-by-design/default; vulnerability & patch management; product lifecycle management; awareness, competence & skills), each scored 1-5 on an anchored rubric. This connector reads the Questionnaire sheet's 25 scores (a stdlib-only .xlsx parser — no openpyxl) and imports them as an SMEMATURITYASSESSMENT + SMEMATURITYANSWER rows (runner.import_sme_maturity), where XORCISM recomputes the domain averages, the overall maturity band (Basic 1-2.5 / Intermediate 2.6-3.9 / Advanced 4-5) and the Annex B improvement roadmap. Offline only (the ENISA tool is a spreadsheet, no API/secrets): pass `file` = the filled ENISA .xlsx or a JSON export ({assessments:[...]} / {scores:{"1.1":3,...}}), or run with no file for the bundled sample (ENISA's worked example, overall 3.0 -> Intermediate). It is a maturity self-check, NOT a proof of CRA compliance.

parameters.name: file
parameters.help: The filled-in ENISA CRA_Maturity_Model_TOOL.xlsx, or a JSON export of the scores

parameters.name: name
parameters.help: Assessment name (defaults to the ENISA tool title)

parameters.name: product_scope
parameters.help: Product(s) with digital elements in scope
